bangla_explanation: Performance appraisal মানে আপনার কাজ কেমন হচ্ছে তার মূল্যায়ন; এখানে ৪টি methods আছে।
Self assessment-এ নিজের diaries বা action plans দেখে নিজেই performance review করেন।
Statistical-এ objective তথ্য লাগে, যেমন client numbers আর client ratings।
Peer or team assessment-এ team members মিটিংয়ে goals আর outcomes মিলিয়ে feedback দেন; formal appraisal প্রতিষ্ঠান নিয়মিত set criteria দিয়ে করে।
Feedback পেলে defensive না হয়ে constructive মনোভাব রাখুন।

example.en: A computer trainer counts how many trainees finish and their ratings. This is a statistical appraisal.
example.bn: কতজন course শেষ করল আর কত rating দিল — এই সংখ্যা দেখা হলো statistical method।

short.prompt: Describe the different performance appraisal methods.
short.modelAnswer:
There are four performance appraisal methods:
1. Self-assessment: uses diaries, action plans or personal records to review performance.
2. Statistical: uses objective information, e.g. client numbers and client ratings.
3. Peer or team assessment: team members give feedback in a group meeting.
4. Formal appraisal: done routinely by the organisation, using set criteria.

keyPoints.text: All forms of appraisal are valuable if received in a constructive, non-defensive spirit.

cites.quote: All of these forms of performance appraisal are valuable to you, particularly if you receive them in a constructive, non-defensive spirit.

keyPoints.text: Self-assessment identifies strengths or weaknesses and the progress of goal achievement.
